title: Green fireballs as mothership hypothesis

plain: In the late 1940s, green fireballs that looked like meteors were seen over US nuclear sites, and Michels offers a hypothesis: a mothership waited outside the atmosphere and the green "meteorites" were tied to the UFOs seen near nuclear weapons. He puts this idea himself to the skeptic Mick West during a debate, drawing on the book UFOs and Nukes. If true, it would mean something was watching America's nuclear program from space.
